$comment: Microsoft Store package identity for OUTARCH. identityName, publisher and publisherDisplayName MUST be copied from Partner Center > your app > Product management > Product identity (Package/Identity/Name, Package/Identity/Publisher, Package/Properties/PublisherDisplayName). A Store build (npm run package:store) refuses the placeholders below. See MICROSOFT_STORE.md.
description: OUTARCH is a local-first developer command center: run and supervise every terminal, dev server and AI coding agent of a project from one window.
shortDescription: Developer command center for terminals and AI coding agents
